note: CONFIRMED live 2026-08-13 with a real authenticated session: BLS's actual date/slot calendar is reached via 'Book appointment' on the authenticated applicant-list page (list-appointment-form-india), which leads to an 'Appointment Booking Form' requiring a distorted-digit image CAPTCHA plus a mobile OTP before you can click Continue. This gate reappears on every booking attempt, not just once at login. There is no selector work that fixes this — the calendar itself is unreachable by automation. src/providers/bls.ts therefore treats a healthy authenticated session as the most it can honestly report (MANUAL_PROCESS_ONLY), and does not attempt to click through to this form. If BLS ever removes or changes this gate, re-run `npm run inspect:bls` (optionally extended to follow the 'Book appointment' link) and revisit bls.ts.
